{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if any rows have status == refunded
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check the unique values in 'channel' and 'customer_segment'
print('\nChannel values:', sales['channel'].unique())
print('Customer segment values:', sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment across channels
segment_channel = pd.crosstab(sales['channel'], sales['customer_segment'])
print('\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', segment_channel)"}
